So! I must say, I am impressed you
got here.\pTEAM ROCKET captures POKéMON from
around the world.\pThey're important tools for keeping
our criminal enterprise going.\pI am the leader, GIOVANNI!\pFor your insolence, you will feel a
world of pain!
I see that you raise POKéMON with\nutmost care.\pA child like you would never\nunderstand what I hope to achieve.\pI shall step aside this time!\pI hope we meet again…
I know you!\nYou ruined our plans at MT. MOON!
Do you have something against TEAM\nROCKET?
How can you not see the beauty of\nour evil?
The elevator doesn't work?\nWho has the LIFT KEY?
Oh, no!\nI dropped the LIFT KEY!
